blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mapua Malayan Colleges Laguna suspended its face-to-face classes and shifted to online classes on Thursday, October 1, due to a reported security concern in its campus. READ: Nationwide rapid alert system eyed for school emergencies – PNP The educational institution made the announcement on Thursday morning, with its directive to suspend onsite classes effective immediately. “On-site classes are suspended effective immediately today, October 1, 2026 as a precaution due to a reported security concern. Those with on-site classes will shift to synchronous classes online,” it said in a statement. READ: PNP eyeing tougher measures, best practices on school […]...
